code.basis: Child line sets in app/workbooks and app/audit from validation, audit, and any correction calls; excludes API, storage, UI, and modules outside those paths.

component.basis: Shared component catalog C1-C12 (specification 3.0.0 section 15) in the frozen suite manifest; a component counts once when a test executed one of its predeclared qualifying assertions in this session, even if it failed. Setup, preparation, accepted-work draining and skipped tests earn nothing. HTTP-only run: C9 user interface needs retained browser/manual evidence and is never counted here, so covered is at most 11.

system.basis: Shared acceptance criteria AC-01 to AC-18 (denominator 18, specification 3.0.0 section 17): a criterion counts once when at least one mapped qualifying assertion executed, even if it failed. This is evaluated coverage, not acceptance. HTTP-only run: AC-17 needs browser/manual accessibility evidence and is never counted here; AC-09 counts only the automated preservation portion (Excel no-repair inspection is separate); AC-16 counts HTTP deletion evidence only (HTTPS, credential protection and backup/restore evidence are manual); AC-18 counts tester-observed real-time runs (target-side queue/engine timing is separate).

model.basis: Team team9 Phase 5 design version 0.1.0: all 23 design requirements (map SHA256 8d8c0719c91b584601bdf89b904170cd06bb6f667707b940d8d59ce98a7654ec); requirements-to-tests mapping https://github.com/JGraff24/30861_Team9/blob/main/docs/design/team9-design-map.json. A requirement counts once when at least one mapped test executed its qualifying assertion in this session, even if it failed; setup, skips and unmapped or untested requirements earn nothing.

known_deviations: HTTP-only run: C9 and AC-17 are never counted; Excel no-repair (AC-09), HTTPS/credential/backup (AC-16) and monitoring evidence are manual.
Local-integration (57) and manual-release (21) plan entries are outside this report; tester-side ones are pytest cases, the rest are target/release evidence.
AC-18 timings are tester-observed end-to-end real time; the target-side validation/queue/engine split is separate (Ryan's measured execution).
Human fixture/Excel review was not performed; no approval is inferred from automated results.
pending_confirmation: Pod adoption of specification/pack 3.0.0 (ADOPTION.md) is not recorded; this executable manifest and its fixture hashes await Team 12 agreement.
Reviewer access assumes the configured reviewer holds a read grant from userA only; the ungranted-reviewer cases read a userB workbook. Team 12 provisioning must match.
Foreign test-admin clock cases need an optional second credential (test-adminB); without it they are reported as skips.

Busy-version, active-deletion and PROCESSING-eligibility cases assert only when the active window is observed on both sides of the call; otherwise they skip as unobservable. A fast target may need target-side local evidence for these.
P5-CLOCK-NOT-READY and P5-FAULT-REJECT-DISABLED are unobservable over HTTP on a deployment whose fault/clock capability is enabled; they report skips.
Synchronous TEST_STORAGE_FAILURE details are not specified; only the code and ProjectError shape are asserted.
Scheduled-audit, notification, report and remediation injected messages follow the section 11 pattern '<Operation> failure requested by the isolated test session.'
Ordinary-namespace probes (fault/clock isolation) upload one clean workbook as userA and remove it with owner deletion; a failed deletion leaves it behind.
Inherited Phase 4 pending items (link targets, check order, formula links, x14 rename, stale-audit observability) are unchanged; see manifest-phase4.json.
